summary.text: Julie Evans is the Democratic nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 64, having advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired special education paraprofessional.

paragraphs.text: Evans listed healthcare, voting and immigration as her three key campaign messages in a Ballotpedia survey.
She said healthcare is a priority in part because her family has a daughter with a disability, and she proposed protecting and expanding the Affordable Care Act and lowering prescription drug costs.
She also named education as a policy area she is passionate about, citing full funding for public education and higher teacher pay.
